question.text: Unabsorbed derivative losses from a recognized stock exchange can be carried forward for a maximum of:

explanation.text: The Logic: As per Income Tax provisions, non-speculative business losses (including derivative losses from recognized exchanges) can be carried forward for a maximum of 8 assessment years. The Trap: Speculative losses have a different carry-forward period (4 years). Since exchange-traded derivative losses are NON-speculative, the 8-year period applies. This distinction is crucial. Cross-Exam Context: Loss carry-forward periods are tested in Series IV and are important tax planning considerations for traders across all derivative markets. Distributor's Pro-Tip: To claim carry-forward, the income tax return must be filed within the due date. A late filing forfeits the carry-forward benefit for that year's losses.
